summary.text: Adam Smith is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 120 since January 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Smith took office representing Kansas House District 120 on January 9, 2017.

Ballotpedia lists his 2023–2024 committee assignments as the Corrections and Juvenile Justice Committee, the House Federal and State Affairs Committee, the Rules and Journal Committee and the Taxation Committee, which he chaired.
